create_aws_iam_user: create an AWS IAM user with a given username using AwsDeploymentHelper.create_user
delete_aws_iam_user: delete an AWS IAM user and all their access keys using AwsDeploymentHelper.delete_user_workflow
create_iam_policy: create an IAM policy from a JSON template with interpolated parameters using AwsDeploymentHelper.create_policy
attach_policy_to_user: attach an existing IAM policy to an AWS IAM user using AwsDeploymentHelper.attach_user_policy
create_user_access_keys: create access and secret keys for an existing AWS IAM user using AwsDeploymentHelper.create_access_key
